compiled_state.title: As a developer, no file in skills/scripts/hooks/workflows references legacy config keys (grep-verified)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update all ~14 `plugins/dso/skills/**/*.md` files, `plugins/dso/scripts/**/*.sh`, `plugins/dso/hooks/**`, and `.github/workflows/*.yml` to eliminate references to the four legacy config keys (`merge.strategy`, `enforcement.strategy`, `worktree.isolation_enabled`, `attribution.enabled`) and the eliminated env vars (`SPRINT_MODE`, `DSO_SPRINT_MODE`, `MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE`). Verified by `grep -rln` with explicit allowlist.

**Why**: SC6 requires grep-verified cleanup as the acceptance criterion. Without it, the shim quietly bridges legacy references in skill files and scripts, masking residual references that would break host projects after the sentinel lockout lands.

**Scope**:
- IN: Skill file (`plugins/dso/skills/**/*.md`) updates; script/hook updates that still reference legacy keys; `.github/workflows/*.yml` env block scan; grep-verification command + allowlist maintenance
- OUT: Reference docs (CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md, INSTALL.md, WORKTREE-GUIDE.md, CI-INTEGRATION.md, dso-config.reference.conf) — updated in S7; migrator script and read-config.sh shim — exempt; tests/ tree — scope-sweep note below

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `grep -rln 'merge\.strategy\|enforcement\.strategy\|worktree\.isolation_enabled\|attribution\.enabled\|SPRINT_MODE\|DSO_SPRINT_MODE\|MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' plugins/dso/skills plugins/dso/scripts plugins/dso/hooks .github/workflows --exclude-dir=tests` returns zero matches outside the explicit allowlist (migrator script, read-config.sh compat shim, reference docs, CLAUDE.md, ADRs)
  ← Satisfies: SC6 (grep-verified cleanup)
- When this story is complete, all ~14 `plugins/dso/skills/**/*.md` files have been updated to use `dso.workflow` language
  ← Satisfies: SC6 (skill files updated)
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Explicit allowlist must be maintained alongside the grep command in the test — adding a new exempt file requires updating both the allowlist and the test
- [Consumer Impact] The `--exclude-dir=tests` escape hatch creates a blind spot: test fixtures or test harness shims that reference legacy keys or eliminated env vars will silently pass the grep check but break after the sentinel lockout lands in a host project. Either (a) include `tests/` in the grep with a narrower allowlist for fixture files that intentionally test legacy-key handling, or (b) add a separate test-directory sweep with its own allowlist. The `.github/workflows/` scan must cover `env:` blocks and `${{ env.* }}` interpolations (not just shell-style `${VAR}` references).

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
